title: 👀 Doomsday plane (75-0125) coming into sight: closest in about 2 min, look SSE, about 7° up, 12 mi away
body:
@RDBFarm — Doomsday plane (75-0125, E-4B Nightwatch) is worth looking for from the farm (2026-10-24 21:17:22 UTC).

- **At its closest** (in about 2 min): look SSE (bearing 151°), about 7° above the horizon, 11.5 miles away, about 7,630 ft up
- **Right now:** S (bearing 186°), 13.8 miles away, about 7,822 ft above the farm's ground, heading ENE, 269 kt
- **Callsign:** CLUB22; ICAO ADFEB6

[ADS-B Exchange](https://globe.adsbexchange.com/?icao=adfeb6) · [Farm receiver (farm network only)](http://192.168.1.190/tar1090/?icao=adfeb6) · [Live map](https://rdbfarm.github.io/iad-map/live.html)

_Automatic alert from `pi/alerts.py`, once per visit. Its path is projected straight ahead at its present course, speed and climb or descent; it alerts only when that path is in sight (within 12 miles, at least 5° up) within 5 minutes for at least a minute. Those limits are estimates; a turn changes the path, and cloud isn't known._
